text.en:
Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred Thirty-Seven is hereby amended by adding the
following section after section twenty thereof, which shall read as follows:
"Sec. 20-A. Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, commercial banking corporations may fix
the number of their directors at any number not less than five (5) nor in excess of fifteen (15).

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
